fusions.name: Talon Stoop
fusions.desc: Dives talons-first at a target up to 5 tiles away, dealing 4 damage, up to 1.8 times that from the full distance.

fusions.name: Downdraft Landing
fusions.desc: Lands from a glide with a beat of wings, dealing 28 damage to every enemy in a cone 4 tiles ahead. Every hit is a critical hit, with a 40% chance to leave the target [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Light-Boned Bound
fusions.desc: Bounds you 2 tiles from where you stood and raises your movement speed by 30% for 8 seconds. You also gain 8% dodge chance.

fusions.name: Flightless Runner
fusions.desc: A bonded flightless bird runs beside you, kicking enemies within 4 tiles for 4 damage every 1.2 seconds.
